name: Hylo HYUSD
oneLiner: HYUSD has an observable V1 Solana-LST pool while current Hylo docs describe an unreconciled V2 architecture spanning SOL, BTC, and USDC pools.
collateral: Observable V1 Solana-LST pool plus an unreconciled documented V2 design with independent SOL-LST, cbBTC, and USDC collateral pools; Hylo has not published a V2 program/xBTC deployment that reconciles the current production state
pegMechanism: Hylo's deployed V1 design uses xSOL to absorb volatility for one shared LST pool. Current V2 docs describe per-asset xASSET/vUSD invariants and isolated collateral ratios across SOL, BTC, and USDC pools, but the live migration state is not published.

oracleRisk.summary: The observable V1 program uses Sanctum LST accounting and Pyth SOL/USD, while current V2 documentation specifies independent SOL/USD, BTC/USD, and USDC/USD paths. Hylo's address directory does not publish a complete deployed V2 program/pool inventory, so the production oracle graph is unresolved.

branchApplicability.rationale: Both the observable V1 pool and the documented V2 per-asset pools issue protocol-level synthetic claims rather than borrower-specific collateralized debt positions. The V2 design isolates collateral ratios by pool, but users still do not maintain individually liquidatable borrower branches. Production activation of the documented V2 pools remains unresolved.

mintAuthority.summary: hyUSD is minted only by depositing Solana LSTs into the Hylo exchange program (HYEXCHt...), which CPI-signs SPL mintTo with its own PDA CfuSViq... (seeds ["mint_auth", hyUSD mint]). Freeze authority is null and the on-chain Anchor IDL exposes no supply cap and no admin mint instruction, so supply is bounded by deposited collateral. The Hylo config admin (fees, oracle, stability thresholds, LST registry) is a Squads v4 multisig vault with a 1-of-4 voting threshold. The BPF upgrade authority for both Hylo programs is a separate Squads v4 vault with a 3-of-4 voting threshold and no timelock; it can redeploy the program and rewrite mint logic.

upgradeability.controlRef: Hylo program upgrade authority (Squads v4 multisig vault)

controls.label: hyUSD mint-authority PDA of the Hylo exchange program
controls.capDescription: No protocol supply cap exists: the on-chain IDL has no cap field for hyUSD and no admin mint instruction. Minting happens only through mint_stablecoin against LST collateral deposited under Hylo's collateral invariant, so the bound is collateral, not a raiseable numeric cap.
controls.evidence: Solana RPC getAccountInfo (jsonParsed) on mint 5YMkXAYccHSGnHn9nob9xEvv6Pvka9DZWH7nTbotTu9E at slot 432850547 returned mintAuthority = CfuSViqf6wvUKEprLhtuCsSanvfAsMbDmkAW92FP95qe, freezeAuthority = null, decimals 6, supply 11551873818410. CfuSViq... is off-curve and is not an initialized account: it is a signer-only PDA, reproduced exactly as findProgramAddress(["mint_auth", hyUSD mint], HYEXCHtHkBagdStcJCp3xbbb9B7sdMdWXFNj6mdsG4hn) with bump 254. Transaction GfB3KWeeBLrpXAx7rzNQQ3oMY5THhshBU1UN4x58Pq2hggZwPENmCeZsNwJiBH4zczSwvTPEhh9JrdJARjBVrFz (slot 432848270) shows HYEXCHt... at CPI stack height 2 invoking SPL Token mintTo with authority CfuSViq..., proving only the exchange program can sign hyUSD mints.

controls.label: Hylo protocol parameter admin (Squads v4 multisig vault, 1-of-4)
controls.capDescription: The admin can change fees, the SOL/USD oracle, oracle confidence tolerance, stability thresholds, treasury, the LST registry and the admin key itself, but the IDL exposes no mint-cap instruction and no admin mint path, so it cannot mint hyUSD or raise a cap.
controls.evidence: The Hylo config PDA (seed "hylo") 9cd2sAfbBvKs4SX9YKo4dcjwP3TgTVQ8dT5koshGcDND, read via getAccountInfo at slot 432851473, carries admin = 12DAP8y5XemtK1pJFNMVVnQugt3PUAbZZr9SmyVvy4Ce. That address is off-curve and derives exactly as Squads v4 vault index 0 of multisig 8CRxGZ3vJLsogg61tF7VHfpyMMaz4YVXX7qwxNDKciRt (program SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf); its transactions execute through that program. Decoded multisig account: threshold 1, time_lock 0, config_authority none (autonomous), 7 members of which 4 hold the Vote permission (mask 7), so approvals are effectively 1-of-4.

controls.label: Hylo program upgrade authority (Squads v4 multisig vault)
controls.capDescription: Redeploying the exchange program can rewrite mint logic and lift the collateral invariant that currently bounds hyUSD supply, so this authority can raise any effective bound. Upgrades are not timelocked and the upgrade authority is not renounced.
controls.evidence: getMultipleAccounts (jsonParsed) at slot 432850965 on the ProgramData accounts of both Hylo programs - exchange HYEXCHt... (BA5b6FzvZ77m7MZbsMEVSCFW1x86f7jM98wjcecVwzYN) and router hyRouTRD... (GCsBXReXttZUUfG1JVxiXMvWPHbWikS3FVdZPy1hjXjM) - returned upgrade authority DLkcqeNNX8nRQgD87DN7LjHkcLQd9K2wuqaCbhkERJxL on both, i.e. not immutable; last deployed at slots 432688395 and 432688695. DLkcqeN... is off-curve, so it cannot be an EOA keypair: it derives exactly as Squads v4 vault index 0 of multisig 2z3t2eBz7VL39Q3vEvaemd5mhT9XLoFofEH2cXvwCJvb and its transactions execute through program SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf. Decoded multisig account: threshold 3, time_lock 0, config_authority none (autonomous), 10 members of which 4 hold the Vote permission (mask 7), so approvals are effectively 3-of-4. The IDL's update_admin instruction additionally requires this upgrade authority as a signer.

review.evidence: Primary Solana mainnet RPC reads on 2026-07-14 (slots 432850547-432851514): mint 5YMkXAYccHSGnHn9nob9xEvv6Pvka9DZWH7nTbotTu9E has mintAuthority CfuSViqf6wvUKEprLhtuCsSanvfAsMbDmkAW92FP95qe and freezeAuthority null; that PDA reproduces as findProgramAddress(["mint_auth", mint], HYEXCHt...) and signs mintTo only via CPI from the exchange program; the on-chain Anchor IDL for HYEXCHt... lists no hyUSD supply cap and no admin mint instruction (user mint_stablecoin plus parameter/admin instructions only); the Hylo config admin is Squads vault 12DAP8y5XemtK1pJFNMVVnQugt3PUAbZZr9SmyVvy4Ce (1-of-4 voters, no timelock); and both Hylo programs' BPF upgrade authority is Squads vault DLkcqeNNX8nRQgD87DN7LjHkcLQd9K2wuqaCbhkERJxL (3-of-4 voters, no timelock, not renounced). The prior review's claim that the upgrade authority is a single EOA keypair is incorrect: the address is off-curve and is a Squads v4 vault PDA.
